description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawattha, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing modifications to land parcel registrations, servitude rights, and expunging particulars related to land titles. The content focuses on land property matters including access rights, encumbrances, and title modifications for specific parcels of land in various locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
